item.title: Wands 2.0
item.creator: Novasoft
item.description:
Unleash your inner wizard with the Wands 2.0 Add‑On! This pack introduces a collection of powerful magical wands & staffs to your world. Cast dynamic light spells & light up your world, bind gunpowder to your wand & blow enemies away, or bind any potion of your choice & become the ultimate wizard!

+ 25+ Wands & staffs to choose from!
+ Custom magic spells!
item.changelog:
+ 12 New staffs to craft and use!
+ New spell book added with 15 colour options
+ 4 New custom spells to bind to wands, staffs, and spell books!
+ Bugs fixed and content polished

faqEntries.heading: What's new in the 2.0 update?
faqEntries.content: We have added staffs, and spell books, so more awesome looking things to bind your spells to!

faqEntries.heading: Are the wands and staffs craftable?
faqEntries.content: Yes! You can craft all our wands, staffs, and spell books in the vanilla crafting table.

faqEntries.heading: How to I cast spells using the wands?
faqEntries.content:
How to Bind and Cast Spells

To cast a spell using a wand, staff, or spell book, you must first bind the spell to that item.

   - Place a cauldron and fill it with water.
   - Drop your wand, staff, or spell book into the cauldron.
   - Add the potion bottle (or the item associated with the spell from the guidebook) into the same cauldron. This binds the spell to your item.

Once a spell is bound:

    - Pick up your wand, staff, or spell book.
    - Interact with it while holding it to cast the primary version of the spell.
    - Crouch + Interact to cast the alternate version of that spell.

faqEntries.heading: What are the wands and staffs crafted out of?
faqEntries.content: Woods and ores are used for the crafting wands and staffs.

faqEntries.heading: Does Wands 2.0 work with other Add-On's?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Wands 2.0 is compatible with other Add-On's from the Marketplace!

faqEntries.heading: What Minecraft versions are supported?
faqEntries.content: This Add-On supports Minecraft Bedrock Edition 1.20 and above.

howToEntries.heading: How to add Wands 2.0 to your world
howToEntries.content: Create a new world, or use an existing world. Edit the world settings, Go down and click on Resource packs, click the Available tab, click 'Owned', find Wands 2.0 Add-On, and then click 'Activate' to apply Wands 2.0 to that world.
